warnings: แปลนคาน พื้น ชั้น 3. Scanned government set; every mark read off zoomed crops (three thirds per sheet).
x chain 1.50 + 18 x 4.00 + 1.50 (73.50 overall line, 72.00 grid total); y chain 1.50 + 8.00 + 2.50 + 1.50; 3.30 from A to the stair-bay B5 printed twice.
R3 cantilevers stand at every grid above A and below D; a few carry no printed mark next to them (flagged) — they are drawn identical to the labelled R3 on both sides.
C-D verticals at grids 3, 6-14, 17 carry no printed mark — element_id null.
Lower stair beam B5 at row B''' (~6.30) is not dimensioned — scaled, confidence 0.6.
Columns are not marked on this sheet (marks C1-C5 are on S-01); column sizes per level are in the S-06 column table.

Floor 3 differs from floor 2: bays 1-2 / 18-19 are hollow core (no 5.30 beam), row C bays 5-15 are B3 and row D bays 5-15 are B2 with hollow core in C-D; B13 on the stair-bay C-D verticals and B13/1 / B12 below D.
